NodeStatus.description:
A node's status is its session's status.

A node reaching `DONE` says nothing about a subgraph it may have spawned.
NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus

NodeType.description: A node's type *is* its entry skill.
NodeType.title: NodeType

ResolvedConfig.description:
What a run actually ran under — recorded so it need not be
reconstructed from shell history.

concurrency.description: How many driven sessions may run at once. Orchestrator interventions are not counted against this.
concurrency.title: Concurrency

orchestrator_model.description: Pinned rather than inherited, so a run's behaviour does not change with the user's editor config.
orchestrator_model.title: Orchestrator Model

run_budget_usd.description: Spend ceiling for the whole run, driven and orchestrator spend together.
run_budget_usd.title: Run Budget Usd

session_budget_usd.description: Spend ceiling passed to each driven session.
session_budget_usd.title: Session Budget Usd

ResolvedConfig.title: ResolvedConfig

RootNode.description:
The run's first session, which predates every graph.

Graphs live beside tickets in the target repo's effort directories, and at
launch no effort directory exists — so the root node lives here instead,
carrying the pasted prompt where every other node carries a ticket.

nudge_count.description: Consecutive stale points at which the owed set did not shrink.
nudge_count.title: Nudge Count

session_id.description: Join key to the session record.
session_id.title: Session Id

type.description: The node's type is its entry skill.

RootNode.title: RootNode

Route.description: Which skill a run enters through. Chosen explicitly, never inferred.
Route.title: Route

RunStatus.description:
A run's coarse state.

`GATED` means strictly "nothing can proceed until a human acts"; a run only
partially blocked stays `RUNNING`.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

description: `run.json`. Written only by the orchestrator, on the loop thread.

branch.description: Checked-out branch, or None when detached.
branch.title: Branch

dirty.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes at launch.
dirty.title: Dirty

orchestrator_spend_usd.description: Spend across orchestrator-agent invocations, counted apart so the harness's own overhead is measurable.
orchestrator_spend_usd.title: Orchestrator Spend Usd

target_repo.description: Absolute path to the target repo.
target_repo.title: Target Repo

worktree.description: The git worktree root the target repo resolved to. Records the state the run was pointed at, never anything the harness did: it creates no branches and no worktrees.
worktree.title: Worktree
